limitations: All model probabilities are uncalibrated estimates unless later established by independent forward evidence.
Football-Data B365H/D/A are pre-closing bookmaker odds; C-suffixed fields are closing odds. Neither source is Taiwan lottery accepted pricing; simulated ROI does not establish Taiwan profitability.
Only events with all four model/market probability vectors enter the same-cohort multiclass comparison.
Paired confidence intervals resample calendar-month blocks on the same match cohort; the supported historical source scope currently covers only EPL and La Liga, not the full production sport set.
Unmapped source team names are preserved as exact normalized source identities and reported; no fuzzy team inference is made.

production_sport_validation_scope.reason: Frozen audited Football-Data.co.uk point-in-time match and B365 H/D/A sources currently cover only English Premier League and Spanish La Liga; Taiwan production market snapshots are not interchangeable with these sources.

protocol.calibration_bins: home-win probability bins; hit-rate and calibration are descriptive, not calibrated quality claims
protocol.fusion_method: independent outcome logits shrunk toward normalized B365 H/D/A by beta=0.65, then normalized to sum 1
protocol.market_baseline: Football-Data.co.uk Bet365 B365H/B365D/B365A pre-closing odds per notes.txt; C-suffixed B365CH/B365CD/B365CA are closing odds and were not used; none are Taiwan accepted prices
protocol.metric_sample_unit: unique league/date/canonical-home/canonical-away match; one multiclass outcome per match
protocol.prediction_cutoff: strict match_date < prediction_date; all same-day results excluded

roi_strategy.selection_rule: one highest expected-value outcome per game
